text: dsh-web-search-bing 是一个 DSH 插件包。仓库中可见的配置通过 cordis.patch.yml 将 id 和 name 为 dsh-web-search-bing 的条目插入 profile layer stack，package.json 将运行入口指向 lib/index.js。当前提交没有包含该入口文件，因此从已读代码只能确认插件条目的接入配置，无法确认运行时注册的搜索能力、输入输出或客户端界面。清单和 README 将它描述为 Bing HTML 搜索 provider，但这里不把未读到实现的能力当作已验证功能。

dsh-web-search-bing is a DSH plugin package. Its bundle patch inserts an entry with this name into the profile layer stack, and its manifest points to lib/index.js. That entry is absent from this commit, so the reviewed code confirms only the hookup configuration, not runtime search behavior.

- DSH_BING_INTERCEPT_HOSTS - comma-separated network intercept gateway hosts; when a fetch redirect lands on one, the fetch errors out immediately instead of returning the block page. Default: empty.
